courses.title: Monitoring and Evaluation in Practice
courses.description: Monitoring and Evaluation in Practice takes you from the basics of monitoring and evaluation to applying it on a realistic Executive Director scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to communication, enough to use it alongside monitoring and evaluation day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying monitoring and evaluation to a real Executive Director scenario
Practicing monitoring and evaluation through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to communication
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Board Governance
courses.description: Applying Board Governance is a focused course on board governance for people already working toward a Executive Director role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying board governance on your own.

courses.title: Getting Started with Volunteer Program Management
courses.description: Getting Started with Volunteer Program Management is a short introduction to volunteer program management for people moving toward a Executive Director role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show volunteer program management in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if volunteer program management is new to you.
